scope: Historical P4O6 source disagreement and a provisional species-specific software recommendation; no production adoption or physical validation is asserted.

molecule.molar_basis: one mole of P4O6, not P2O3

Burcat_Gurvich.uncertainty_limit: Source-reported uncertainty; neither a calibrated probability distribution nor independently validated here.

Morgon_2012.inspection: abstract only; no molecule-specific error bound adopted

Lee_2024.method: G4 electronic energy with specified molecular and atomic references
Lee_2024.inspection: Table 2 visually inspected; formation enthalpy and Gibbs energy kept distinct

sources.location: O-087 298.15 K row and footer; printed p. 1803 / PDF page 87 evaluation notes
sources.source_role: primary for table contents; compilation for original calorimetry
sources.finding: Gas energy uses Koerner and Daniels liquid formation enthalpy plus Farr vaporization contribution. Evaluation remains December 1962; 1998 is publication, not reevaluation.
Original full experiment unavailable. JANAF identifies red-phosphorus combustion in nitric oxide in a flow calorimeter; no independent reconstruction of its product analysis.

sources.citation: T.V.A. Chemical Engineering Report No. 8 (1950), as cited by JANAF
sources.finding: Original vaporization report not recovered; the adopted increment was inspected in JANAF.

sources.location: Publisher abstract and bibliography, not subscription full text
sources.finding: Directly questions whether the old red-P/NO combustion products were conclusively identified as only P4O6 and P4O10. The new calorimetric derivation and any quantitative impurity correction remain uninspected.

sources.citation: Thermodynamic Properties of Individual Substances, fourth edition, volume 1; part 1 p. 413, part 2 p. 266, as identified by NASA
sources.finding: Original evaluation pages were not recovered. Exact choice and weighting of experiments cannot be independently reconstructed.
Selects -1606000 J/mol for P4O6 and explicitly identifies the Gurvich pages. CEA/Burcat agreement is common ancestry, not independent experimental replication.

sources.location: P4O6 CAS10248-58-5; concrete 2016 and 2023 files in pinned GGChem archive plus mirror
sources.finding: Selects Gurvich1989 -1606 +/-40 kJ/mol, rejects JANAF anchor, and lists older Lewis -2144.519. The selected P4O6 polynomial has 200-6000 K representation bounds, not physical validation across that range.

sources.source_role: primary atmospheric analysis; secondary account of historical calorimetry
sources.finding: Traces Gurvich/CEA to Hartley-McCoubrey and favors it over the older experiment. Also records the earlier opposing judgement of Fegley-Lodders. Historical link remains indirect without Gurvich pages.
Independent composite calculation reports -1706.3 kJ/mol. P4O6 is explicitly an exception to desired general accuracy; no general method error is assigned to this molecule.

sources.location: Section 2.1.1, Appendix A.2, Table 2 on author manuscript p. 18
sources.finding: Independent G4 result supports a much less negative P4O6 energy; the model separately adopts NASA/Gurvich and Burcat for consistency. Molecular calculation and database adoption are not counted as two experimental validations.
Knudsen-cell mass spectrometry reports an atomization energy of 4385 (+40,-60) kJ/mol for P4O6. Full thermal/reference conversion to formation enthalpy was not inspected and is not performed here.
Confirms vapor mass-spectrometric experiments; available abstract does not independently establish the 298 K formation enthalpy quoted by later authors.

Qualitative chemical constraints favor less stabilization than JANAF and improved measurements. Its numerical reconstruction is not adopted: phase labels and formation-entropy usage require clarification against the primary JANAF liquid-origin note and absolute-entropy column.

sources.location: Sections 1 and 2 and tables reviewed in phosphorus_sources_20261030.json
sources.finding: Documents white/red-V phosphorus reference correction and PH/PH3/PN problems. It does not supply an explanation of the full P4O6 JANAF/Gurvich gap.

reference_checks.old_Lewis_correction_hypothesis: Near equality with 4*17.46 is suggestive only; the old file lineage has not been reconstructed and does not explain the modern 608.307 gap.
reference_checks.molecular_normalization: Both current records describe gas P4O6; no factor-of-two conversion is indicated.
reference_checks.pressure_standard: Ideal-gas formation enthalpy is not shifted by changing 1 atm to 1 bar; pressure-reference Gibbs/entropy conversions remain necessary.
reference_checks.elemental_gauge: If g_i changes by sum_e A_ei*c_e consistently, G changes by constant sum_e b_e*c_e at fixed inventory. Balanced reaction energies and equilibrium composition are invariant.
reference_checks.gas_constant: P4O6 NASA7 H298 is -1605.9999975 kJ/mol with R=8.31451 and -1605.9926576 with R=8.314472; this convention difference is negligible relative to608.307.
reference_checks.limit: These checks rule out simple bookkeeping explanations of the full gap; they do not reconstruct all historical laboratory conversions or the exact FastChem fit.

H3PO4.inspection_limit: Burcat record inspected; original calculation output not inspected. Liquid/crystalline acid records are distinct.

HPO2.selected_source: Haworth and Bacskay, JCP117(2002)11175, label T11/12
HPO2.inspection_limit: Burcat comment inspected; original paper tables not independently audited.

P4S3.selected_source: Same Stock/Kitzmann fit in both native selections; Chase/JANAF1998 annotation in FastChem4
P4S3.interpretation: No changed-source driver in the Ohno experiment. Small abundance is specific to the declared sampled conditions.

recommendation.preference: Pinned Gurvich-derived P4O6 record over the strongly stabilizing JANAF record, provisionally.
positive_evidence: Specific criticism of old product identification, not database age alone.
Independent molecular calculations favor the less negative energy family.
Current curated already uses the corresponding FastChem4 branch; retaining its version preserves reproducibility.
not_established: Complete cold phosphorus network or source fit intervals are physically validated.
Exact archived2016file was the input to the FastChem refit.
recommendation.production_behavior: Unchanged curated-gas-v1; P4O6 remains inherited_unreviewed, with the existing 1500-4000 K evaluation interval.
software_actions: Keep source alternatives explicit and versioned.
Record source/phase/reference/temperature validity with each species choice.
Treat missing gases and condensed phases separately from energy replacement.
Report source sensitivity as alternative scenarios, not statistical error bars.
Require an explicit reviewed species decision and new dataset identity for any future release change.

remaining_work: Inspect original Gurvich1989 part1p413 and part2p266 and original1952/1963 calorimetry.
Recover exact FastChem P4O6 input, atomic references and fitting grid/weights.
Audit original H3PO4/HOPO computational provenance and common low-temperature validity.
Review relevant condensed phases and independent physical constraints for intended atmospheres.

hash_algorithms.file: SHA256 of the unmodified complete file bytes.
hash_algorithms.record_bytes: SHA256 of four complete NASA7 record lines including original line endings; starts at 1-based line recorded for the species.
hash_algorithms.coefficient: Read first75columns of each of three coefficient lines as5fields of15columns; parse floats; retain first14values (high-T7 then low-T7, excluding15th auxiliary hf298/R value); SHA256 of json.dumps(coefficients).encode() using Python defaults (ASCII, comma-space separator). Header names and phase are excluded from this coefficient hash; species and gas-phase identity are checked separately.
hash_algorithms.gas_formation_enthalpy: For low-T coefficients a1..a7 and T298.15: H=R*T*(a1+a2*T/2+a3*T**2/3+a4*T**3/4+a5*T**4/5+a6/T)/1000 kJ/mol; both R values recorded.
